reviews.x: I bought this for my 12 yr old daughter who was born with an accessory navicular bone and had chronic foot pain.  she wants to hold off on surgery a bit longer.  She really loved it at first and used it every night.  But after about 10 uses, the right side stopped bubbling.  She uses it by alternating one foot over the bubbles , but I will have to consider another option for her.  A disappointment.  I would not recommend it.
i've used this footbath several times now after work and find it very relaxing. i'm on my feet all day at work and they start to ache by evening, this makes them feel brand new and young again.

Very relaxing footbath. I'm not sure I agree with the other reviewer who said it doesn't make the water warm enough - unless he just likes the skin boiled off of his feet, this gets plenty hot enough for me, someone who likes his feet not scalded. (Everybody knows if you're a real reviewer you can't like anything and have to find something to criticize, maybe that's what's going on, lol)The different modes were pretty good, I liked the vibration massage most. I walk a lot and am on my feet often

reviews.t: Can’t wait to Soak My Feet
reviews.x: I went through 2 different foot spas and this one is the best! It heats the water up gently, soothes the feet, and smells good with foot balm added.

I am officially using the Beurer Foot Spa Massager every night. I am able to relax my feet after a long day and feel like I’m bringing a spa into my home. The water is kept heated and it’s design and handle are perfect for carrying it around the bathroom with no spillage. Gifting everyone I know one of these for the holidays!!
It works but its awkward and spills easily. The teno is not high and the vibration is weak. Oh and the rollers are crap and unusable.  All in all i would spend a bit more and get a better one.
Works as advertised. Lots of soft bubbles. Not deep enough for my preference.
Remote can be finicky but otherwise good pedicure bowl
Sometimes you just need a stress reliever in your home and this is it!!! the attachments are great, and it kept the water warm!! Only my first use, but so far I love it!!
The heat isn't hot even if u use hot water and its not that deep i don't like it

Feet feel great during and afterwards!
It was delivered today and I had to try it immediately.  Very pleased.  Easy to carry when filled and easy to empty and clean. Very nice, strong bubbles and soothing vibration.
This item was purchased for my Aunt.  It is simple to use and met all her expectations.

reviews.t: Vibration is the only real value
reviews.x: Having spent 16 hours traveling in one day and walking my 10,000 steps on hard airport floors, I unboxed this foot spa with real anticipation - my feet were killing me. The instructions were minimal but it's not difficult to figure out, so I had it ready to go in a couple of minutes. Short review: my feet felt better after using this, but the gimmicks get in the way.  Pros: 1. Carry handle works well. It's relatively easy to carry this to and from the sink when full, provided you're okay with th

I'm a fan of pedicures. I get one every other week, sometimes my daughter goes as well. I used this on myself and my 5 yr old. This isn't any better than the Conair we own. It doesn't do anything special to warrant such a high price of 68.47. We both liked it as a fun little thing to do at home but we won't be skipping the salon.

reviews.t: In love with my new foot spa
reviews.x: In love with my new foot spa! It is amazing for at home pedicures, and overall relaxing and soothing. It keeps the water hot which is my favorite part – I can sit at home and relax. Well designed, will definitely make a good gift when the holidays come around.

claims.text: Many reviewers find the foot bath relaxing and enjoy using it after a long day on their feet.
Several reviewers say the water does not stay warm or get hot enough.
Some reviewers find the basin not deep enough for their preference.
A few reviewers report durability or usability problems, such as the bubbling stopping or the unit spilling easily.
Some reviewers describe the massage or vibration as weak and the rollers unusable.
